Battery recycling plant opens in Ridgefield

By Staff Reporter

A battery recycling plant opened in Ridgefield on Tuesday.

The plant will recover lithium, nickel and cobalt from used electric car batteries.

Owner Greenloop said it can process 10,000 tons of batteries a year.

The plant employs 150 workers.

Governor Alana Reyes attended the opening and called battery recycling essential for the state's clean energy plans.

Greenloop plans a second plant in 2028.
